title: Pipkin
description: Cooked Tuesday, at your door Friday. A pastel jam-shop page that follows one jar from order to doorstep through five illustrated scenes, then lets you build a box.
stack: Next.js 16 · React 19 · Original SVG · CSS Motion · Lenis

fonts.name: Font / Display
fonts.fallback: Arial Rounded MT Bold, system-ui, sans-serif

sections.title: Header
sections.summary: fixed pill bar; compresses with a blurred background after 80px, hides on scroll-down and returns on scroll-up; a nav indicator that slides between links and follows the active section; a cart pill showing the jar count; a Magnetic "Order" button; below 960px a round toggle that morphs to ✕ and opens a full-screen butter menu with a circle clip-path wipe, staggered links, scroll lock, focus trap and Esc to close.

sections.title: Hero
sections.summary: grid with copy left and art right. An "Order #0412 placed · Mon 9:41" pill, the h1 "Cooked [[Tuesday.]] At your door Friday.", a lede, two CTAs ("Build a box", "Follow a jar"), three facts. Art: a sky circle with three jars (lilac "No. 05", bubblegum "No. 01", butter "No. 02"), three chips ("Made Tuesday", "Real fruit, no pectin", "Batch No. 17") and sparkles. Four soft pastel blobs drift behind.

sections.title: Flavour band
sections.summary: a rotated bubblegum strip with a looping marquee of six flavour pills.

sections.title: The Shelf
sections.summary: six flavour cards (Strawberry & Basil, Meyer Lemon Marmalade, Pear & Vanilla Bean, Blueberry & Thyme, Plum & Lavender, Peach & Chamomile) with filter chips (All six / Fruity / Floral / Tangy), $9 each, an "Add to box" button.

sections.title: Build a Box
sections.summary: size toggle (3 / 6 / 12 jars), a yellow box of slots that fill with jars, a stepper per flavour, a live total (1 jar $9; $1 off from 3, $4 off from 6, $12 off at 12; shipping $6 under 6 jars, free from 6), "Place order", loading, then a success ticket. The shelf buttons and the header counter share the same box state.

sections.title: Batch Day
sections.summary: four count-up stats (36 jars, 2 cooks, 72 h, 1,208 notes) and a Mon–Fri week strip joined by a drawn dashed line.

sections.title: Doorstep Notes
sections.summary: two rows of customer-note cards drifting in opposite directions, pausing on hover.

sections.title: Questions
sections.summary: five-item accordion (height via `grid-template-rows`), one open at a time.

sections.title: The Friday List
sections.summary: a signup form (first name, email, a "which jar do you lean towards?" pill radio group). No network: validate on the client, shake invalid fields, show a loading button, then a circle wipe to a success card.

sections.title: Footer
sections.summary: plum slab, link columns, a giant "pipkin" wordmark that rises through a mask.

sections.title: Order placed
sections.summary: a phone on the counter with a notification, a ringing bell, a receipt ticket; the jar is a dashed ghost outline. Sky.

sections.title: Cooking
sections.summary: a lilac stockpot of bubbling jam, a stirring spoon, steam, a ladle pouring a stream; the jar fills with jam as you scroll. Butter.

sections.title: Packed
sections.summary: tape, tissue, stickers, a pencil and a hanging "Handle with jam" tag; the jar gets its lid and sits in an open box, the box lid beside it. Mint.

sections.title: Out for delivery
sections.summary: a pink pickup with a flat bed carrying the closed box, a scrolling road, houses and trees; wheels spin with scroll. Lilac.

sections.title: Delivered
sections.summary: a front door, windows, a mat and a plant; the box lid lifts off and lands beside it, the jar pops up and settles, sparkles twinkle, a "Delivered · 11:20" banner appears. Blush.
